title: Rep. Jordan Backs Trump's $5,000 Dividend Plan
description:
US Rep. Jim Jordan, a Republican from Ohio, and a close ally of President Donald Trump, supports Trump's plan to give US adults a payment of $5,000. But Jordan says he would like to see more details. He also says Republicans will keep their majority in Congress after the midterms. He speaks on "Balance of Power" from Dallas.
